name: Maria no Jisatsu
source:
Inspired by "The Virgin Suicides."

Two sisters commit suicide, a month apart, and no one can understand why.  Why would they kill themselves?  And what is the meaning of the red ribbons they left tied around the statue of the Virgin Mary?
translation:
灵感来自《处女自杀》。

两姐妹自杀了，相隔一个月，没有人能理解其中的原因。他们为什么要自杀？他们留下的绑在圣母玛利亚雕像上的红丝带有何意义？
